category.quote: The universe of eligible beneficiaries under PMAY-G will include all the houseless households living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roofs (as per SECC data, and subject to the exclusion process).

gate_notes: The scheme targets housing deprivation across all social categories and does not specify age, income or occupation restrictions; prioritisation criteria are complex but do not constitute exclusive eligibility facets.
